card.name: Mixing and dilution instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside preparation steps for diluting or reconstituting a drug, such as withdrawing a volume, adding to saline, or mixing a powder in water. Often falls on a linking word or partway through a drug name just before the diluent or product is named.

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: Inside a drug name in a withdraw-and-dilute step.

modes.label: Linking words before diluent
modes.description: Small words like to, into, or on right before the diluent or amount is named.
modes.example: Add the required volume of GAZYVA solution slowly<< into>> the 0.9% Sodium Chlor

modes.label: Dilution table terms
modes.description: Column labels or numbers in volume tables and formulas.
modes.example: Volume of<< Added>> Liquid (mL) Volume of OM

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from additive-like ingredient words and toward continuing the named product or diluent.
card.plain: It marks the spot in mixing instructions where a drug or diluent name is about to be continued or given.
